description: Shared Renovate preset for DPYC ecosystem repos. Tuned for LOW NOISE: one weekly batch, throttled PR volume, aggressively grouped, and settled-release-only. The ONLY thing that self-merges is the tollbooth-dpyc == pin (patch/minor) — and only where the repo grants the Renovate app a branch-protection bypass. Everything else waits for owner review by design (crypto/PII federation: a human sees every dependency change). platformAutomerge is FALSE on purpose: our repos gate merges with a ruleset that grants the Renovate app (Integration) a bypass, and GitHub's native auto-merge does NOT honor ruleset bypass — it parks a green PR forever. Direct merge (platformAutomerge:false) uses the app's bypass and actually lands. OSV vulnerability alerts are ON: Renovate detects and opens security bump PRs fleet-wide (no LLM) — dependency CVEs are Renovate's job, never the Journeyman's.

packageRules.description: SDK pin — keep tollbooth-dpyc pinned to the exact == version on every update type. (rangeStrategy lives in its OWN rule: Renovate rejects combining it with matchUpdateTypes.)
SDK patch/minor — the ONE thing that self-merges (via a per-repo Renovate branch-protection bypass), on green CI; not delayed by minimumReleaseAge because we trust our own wheel immediately.
SDK major bumps — always manual review (breaking changes).
All GitHub Actions bumps collapsed into ONE PR; owner reviews (only the SDK pin bypasses the money-gate).
Ignore Python 3.14 — coincurve/cffi not compatible yet.
Collapse all non-SDK Python dependency bumps into one PR.
Collapse all npm/frontend dependency bumps into one PR (tames the taxsort + excalibur churn).
